title: Deeper In
summary: The flag you want is on a machine you can't reach. The way to it runs through a server that sits on two networks. Own the first, then use it to see the second.
story: Thornfield Freight (made up) keeps its real server on an inside network, 10.10.72.0/24, that your box can't reach. Between you and it is a jump host, jump01, with one foot on your network (10.10.7.0/24) and one foot inside. You start on scout.
goal: Capture the flag on the jump host and the flag on the inside server, store01.
skills: pivoting, dual-homed hosts, scanning from a foothold, ssh through a jump host, reused credentials

hints.text: Scan your network: nmap -sn 10.10.7.0/24 finds jump01 at 10.10.7.20. It runs FTP (21) that allows anonymous access; read the files in pub.
A note in FTP gives the pilot password. ssh pilot@10.10.7.20 for the first flag. Then run ip addr on jump01: it is also on 10.10.72.0/24, a network your box can't see.
From jump01, scan the inside network (nmap -sn 10.10.72.0/24) and reach store01 at 10.10.72.10. The pilot password is reused there: ssh pilot@10.10.72.10.
